policy.goal: Maximise intelligibility, accurate key-detail transfer, listening recognition, and successful repair; never remove an accent.
policy.reference_model: General American broad IPA supports consistent course models and SSML authoring but is not an imitation target.
policy.variation: Accept stable intelligible English varieties and learner pronunciations when the intended word, contrast, and interaction remain clear.
policy.risk_use: Arabic-learner risks are dialect-sensitive hypotheses requiring observation; they are not facts about an individual learner.

targets.title: Letter names and spelling-sound verification
targets.feature_or_contrast: Recognise the English letter name and check a heard model or IPA for irregular high-value spellings rather than applying one fixed letter-sound rule.
targets.meaning_risk: A spelling-driven guess can make a name, digit, or key word unrecognisable.
targets.mastery_evidence: Hear a fresh key word, select its matching written form, then repeat or spell it when misunderstood.
targets.not_yet: No full phonics or spelling-to-sound system is promised at A1.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Distinguish selected high-value sounds, word boundaries, names, numbers, and learnt chunks in very clear speech.

targets.title: Segment names, numbers, and key details
targets.feature_or_contrast: Hear word boundaries and grouping in very clear names, phone digits, dates, times, prices, and learnt chunks.
targets.meaning_risk: A boundary or grouping error changes the recorded identity, time, or amount.
targets.mastery_evidence: Record a fresh slowly spoken name plus digit sequence, then confirm the grouping accurately.
targets.not_yet: Fast unscripted segmentation and unfamiliar proper names remain later or repair-supported.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Distinguish selected high-value sounds, word boundaries, names, numbers, and learnt chunks in very clear speech.

targets.title: /p/ and /b/
targets.feature_or_contrast: Keep voiceless /p/ and voiced /b/ distinct in selected practical words.
targets.meaning_risk: A merger can change the requested item, place, or key noun.
targets.mastery_evidence: Choose and say the intended fresh /p/- or /b/-initial word so a listener selects the correct item.
targets.not_yet: Do not drill the contrast if the learner already distinguishes it reliably.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Produce selected high-impact consonant contrasts clearly enough in names, numbers, key nouns, verbs, and chunks.

targets.title: /f/ and /v/
targets.feature_or_contrast: Keep /f/ and /v/ distinct in family, number, and high-utility description words.
targets.meaning_risk: A merger can obscure a number, family word, or intensified description.
targets.mastery_evidence: Discriminate and produce the intended fresh number or family word in an information gap.
targets.not_yet: Do not assume the issue from the learner's Arabic dialect or identity.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Produce selected high-impact consonant contrasts clearly enough in names, numbers, key nouns, verbs, and chunks.

targets.title: /θ/ and /ð/ in selected high-value words
targets.feature_or_contrast: Produce or repair the voiceless and voiced dental-fricative categories in a bounded repertoire.
targets.meaning_risk: Substitution can obscure numbers or frequent social and reference words.
targets.mastery_evidence: Make the intended fresh number or chunk intelligible; use repetition or spelling if the first attempt fails.
targets.not_yet: Accent imitation and exhaustive /θ/-/ð/ lexical coverage are not required.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Produce selected high-impact consonant contrasts clearly enough in names, numbers, key nouns, verbs, and chunks.

targets.title: Selected /iː/-/ɪ/ and /uː/-/ʊ/ contrasts
targets.feature_or_contrast: Keep selected tense/lax high-vowel categories distinct where they identify a course word.
targets.meaning_risk: A merger can obscure a number, colour, size, food, or object word.
targets.mastery_evidence: Hear and produce the intended fresh word so the listener selects the correct number, object, or food.
targets.not_yet: Only course-critical words are assessed; a complete English vowel inventory waits.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Produce selected meaning-changing vowel contrasts in a bounded learnt repertoire with modelling and repair.

targets.title: Selected /æ/, /ɛ/, and /ʌ/ categories
targets.feature_or_contrast: Keep selected front and central vowel categories distinct in practical A1 words.
targets.meaning_risk: A merger can change a person, object, room, or transport word.
targets.mastery_evidence: Discriminate and produce the word that identifies a fresh visual or requested object.
targets.not_yet: Learner-specific stable intelligible variants are accepted; no native-vowel target is imposed.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Produce selected meaning-changing vowel contrasts in a bounded learnt repertoire with modelling and repair.

targets.title: Can versus can't in context
targets.feature_or_contrast: Use context, prominence, vowel quality, and especially the final /t/ cue to distinguish can from can't.
targets.meaning_risk: Confusing ability with inability reverses the message.
targets.mastery_evidence: A listener correctly identifies ability or inability in fresh positive and negative statements.
targets.not_yet: Reduced-form mastery and dialect-wide can/can't acoustics remain later; repair is always acceptable.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Produce selected meaning-changing vowel contrasts in a bounded learnt repertoire with modelling and repair.

targets.title: Preserve selected initial clusters
targets.feature_or_contrast: Avoid inserting an extra vowel inside selected course-critical initial clusters.
targets.meaning_risk: An inserted vowel can delay or block recognition of a destination, number, transport word, or season.
targets.mastery_evidence: Produce a fresh target word without adding a syllable; repair with slower chunking if needed.
targets.not_yet: Complex cluster mastery outside the selected words waits.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Preserve selected final consonants and simple clusters when they carry essential word identity or meaning.

targets.title: Preserve meaning-bearing final consonants
targets.feature_or_contrast: Keep selected final consonants or clusters audible when they identify a route, sequence, item, or request.
targets.meaning_risk: Final deletion can change a route, order, payment method, or help request.
targets.mastery_evidence: A listener selects the intended fresh direction, sequence word, or item without needing a written cue.
targets.not_yet: Minor release differences are accepted when the word and contrast remain clear.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Preserve selected final consonants and simple clusters when they carry essential word identity or meaning.

targets.title: Plural, possessive, and third-person -s endings
targets.feature_or_contrast: Make /s/, /z/, or /ɪz/ audible in selected plurals, possessives, and third-person present forms.
targets.meaning_risk: Omission can hide number, ownership, or who performs a routine.
targets.mastery_evidence: Describe fresh people or objects so a listener hears the intended number, owner, or third-person fact.
targets.not_yet: Rule naming is optional; intelligible use in selected words is required.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Make selected plural, possessive, and simple verb endings audible when omission changes immediate meaning.

targets.title: Limited past -ed endings
targets.feature_or_contrast: Recognise and produce /t/, /d/, and /ɪd/ in the bounded A1 past repertoire.
targets.meaning_risk: Deleting the ending can remove the completed-past signal; adding a syllable everywhere harms recognition.
targets.mastery_evidence: Produce two fresh bounded past facts with an audible ending that a listener identifies correctly.
targets.not_yet: A broad irregular-past or past-ending inventory waits for A2.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Make selected plural, possessive, and simple verb endings audible when omission changes immediate meaning.

targets.title: -teen versus -ty stress
targets.feature_or_contrast: Keep final stress and long /iː/ in -teen distinct from first-syllable stress and final /i/ in -ty.
targets.meaning_risk: Stress confusion changes ages, times, prices, and quantities.
targets.mastery_evidence: A listener records the correct fresh -teen or -ty figure without seeing it.
targets.not_yet: Natural fast-speech variation is not required; clear contrast is.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Place recognisable stress in selected names, numbers, nationalities, jobs, and other lesson-critical words.

targets.title: Stress in names, jobs, months, and nationalities
targets.feature_or_contrast: Store a recognisable stress pattern with each personally or lesson-critical multisyllabic word.
targets.meaning_risk: Spelling-led stress can make an otherwise correct identity detail hard to recognise.
targets.mastery_evidence: Deliver fresh personally relevant names and details with recognisable primary stress; spell to repair when needed.
targets.not_yet: Only selected course words and the learner's own details are assessed.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Place recognisable stress in selected names, numbers, nationalities, jobs, and other lesson-critical words.

targets.title: Stress in familiar compound labels
targets.feature_or_contrast: Recognise and reproduce the main stress in selected multiword labels as learnt units.
targets.meaning_risk: Equal or misplaced stress can slow recognition of the requested field or destination.
targets.mastery_evidence: A listener selects the correct fresh familiar compound from speech without a written label.
targets.not_yet: Productive compound-stress generalisation waits; taught labels are whole units.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Place recognisable stress in selected names, numbers, nationalities, jobs, and other lesson-critical words.

targets.title: Hear and highlight the key detail
targets.feature_or_contrast: Notice and imitate prominence on the name, number, price, time, destination, item, or need that carries the contrast.
targets.meaning_risk: Equal prominence can hide which detail is new or corrected.
targets.mastery_evidence: After one model, highlight the changed detail in a fresh short contrast so the listener identifies it.
targets.not_yet: Natural English rhythm, reductions, and native-like timing are not A1 mastery demands.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Notice and imitate prominence inside short learnt chunks without a natural-rhythm mastery demand.

targets.title: Recognise frequent contractions in clear chunks
targets.feature_or_contrast: Recognise and optionally use the taught contracted forms without requiring fast or heavily reduced speech.
targets.meaning_risk: Failure to recognise a contraction can hide identity, negation, a question, a request, or a future commitment.
targets.mastery_evidence: Identify the full meaning of a fresh clear contracted chunk and produce either the contracted or full intelligible form.
targets.not_yet: Assimilation, elision, and fast casual reduction beyond the registered chunks wait.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Recognise a small set of frequent linked or reduced forms inside familiar, very clear chunks.

targets.title: Recognisable social and question contours
targets.feature_or_contrast: Use or imitate a recognisable contour for a greeting, wh-question, yes/no check, and polite response while accepting variety.
targets.meaning_risk: A flat or mismatched contour can make a check sound like a statement or obscure turn completion.
targets.mastery_evidence: A partner identifies the fresh utterance as greeting, question/check, or response without an answer-revealing script.
targets.not_yet: No single universal rise/fall pattern or emotion-reading claim is imposed.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Use recognisable contours in a few learnt greetings, questions, checks, and polite responses.

targets.title: Deliver short sense groups with safe pauses
targets.feature_or_contrast: Group a short learnt message into meaning units and pause between units rather than inside a key name, number, or phrase.

course_examples.text: My name is Mona | I'm from Cairo.
course_examples.reference_ipa: /maɪ ˈneɪm ɪz ˈmoʊnə | aɪm frəm ˈkaɪroʊ/

targets.meaning_risk: An unsafe pause can split a name, number, destination, or request and change what the listener records.
targets.mastery_evidence: Deliver a fresh two- or three-unit message with intelligible key details and pauses at meaning boundaries.
targets.not_yet: Long-turn fluency and spontaneous discourse chunking wait.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Deliver short learnt sense groups, pause safely, and repeat or spell a key item when not understood.

targets.title: Repeat, slow, or spell a key item to repair
targets.feature_or_contrast: Notice a listener signal and repair the key item through slower repetition, contrast, or spelling.
targets.meaning_risk: Without repair, a correctable name, number, item, or place remains misunderstood.
targets.mastery_evidence: After a fresh misunderstanding signal, repair only the key detail until the partner selects it correctly.
targets.not_yet: Repair success matters more than producing the reference model on the first attempt.
targets.teaching_reference: General American broad IPA for modelling only
targets.assessment_tolerance: Accept any stable intelligible variety; require repair only when the target distinction or key detail is lost.
targets.level_expectation: Deliver short learnt sense groups, pause safely, and repeat or spell a key item when not understood.

risk_dispositions.statement: Some learners may merge English /p/ and /b/ in perception or production.
risk_dispositions.rationale: Target only after task impact or learner observation; never infer need from Arabic identity alone.

risk_dispositions.statement: Some learners may merge English /v/ and /f/ in perception or production.
risk_dispositions.rationale: Target only after task impact or learner observation; never infer need from Arabic identity alone.

risk_dispositions.statement: English /θ/ and /ð/ may be replaced by different stops or fricatives; patterns vary by Arabic dialect.
risk_dispositions.rationale: Target only after task impact or learner observation; never infer need from Arabic identity alone.

risk_dispositions.statement: Some learners may add /g/ after /ŋ/ or replace it in unfamiliar word positions.
risk_dispositions.rationale: No current high-value A1 outcome justifies pre-teaching; never infer the need from identity, and add support only if observed.

risk_dispositions.statement: Contrasts such as /iː/-/ɪ/ and /uː/-/ʊ/ may need explicit perception and meaning-based practice.
risk_dispositions.rationale: Target only after task impact or learner observation; never infer need from Arabic identity alone.

risk_dispositions.statement: English /æ/, /e/, /ʌ/, and related vowels may be mapped onto a smaller learner-specific set.
risk_dispositions.rationale: Target only after task impact or learner observation; never infer need from Arabic identity alone.

risk_dispositions.statement: Some learners may insert a vowel into unfamiliar initial or final consonant clusters.
risk_dispositions.rationale: Target only after task impact or learner observation; never infer need from Arabic identity alone.

risk_dispositions.statement: Final consonants or clusters may be reduced when several articulatory demands occur together.
risk_dispositions.rationale: Target only after task impact or learner observation; never infer need from Arabic identity alone.

risk_dispositions.statement: Plural, third-person, possessive, and past endings may be omitted or given an extra syllable.
risk_dispositions.rationale: Target only after task impact or learner observation; never infer need from Arabic identity alone.

risk_dispositions.statement: Stress may follow spelling or a familiar Arabic pattern rather than the English lexical pattern.
risk_dispositions.rationale: Target only after task impact or learner observation; never infer need from Arabic identity alone.

risk_dispositions.statement: Function words may receive equal prominence, limiting English focus and rhythm cues.
risk_dispositions.rationale: Target only after task impact or learner observation; never infer need from Arabic identity alone.

risk_dispositions.statement: English spelling may encourage a stable letter-to-sound guess where pronunciation is irregular.
risk_dispositions.rationale: Target only after task impact or learner observation; never infer need from Arabic identity alone.
